info.description: Initial local owner API. Ordinary family accounts require policy enforcement and are not accepted yet. Playback/download endpoints are not implemented.

get.description: Owner-only catalog. All filters combine with AND; genre matches its vocabulary slug. Text search matches title, Arabic title and aliases. Stable SQL pagination.
